                       6) TT FLASH -> ON

               ** Function Name:      static uint8 CtrlTtGetStateByte(uint8 IgnSts, uint8 tt_state_byte)
               ** Description:        function will return the battery status
               ** Input Parameters:   IgnSts, tt_state_byte
               ** Outputs:            STATE_BYTE

               static uint8 CtrlTtGetStateByte(uint8 IgnSts, uint8 tt_state_byte)
               {

7 0     (T)    CtrlTtGetStateByte

                 }
                 else 
7 3     (T)(F)       if (
7 3.1   (T)(F)       IgnSts == 2U)

                 else 
7 4     (T)(F)         if (
7 4.1   (T)(F)         IgnSts == 4U)

                 }
                 else

                    ** programming purposes.
                    */
                 }

10 1.1  (T)(F)   index < (23U); index++)

10 2    (T)(F)     if (
10 2.1  (T)(F)     ((tt_ctrl_ttconfig[index].Operational_states) & tt_state_byte) != 0x00u)

               /*============================================================================
                ** Function Name       :uint8 CtrlTtCheckBatteryStatus(uint8 index, uint8 l_turn_on_off, uint8 battery_status)
                ** Description         :This function is used to check the Battery status for all the telltales.
                **
                ** Input Parameters:   : index, l_turn_on_off, battery_status
                ** Outputs             : TT_Status
                **==========================================================================*/
               uint8 CtrlTtCheckBatteryStatus(uint8 index, uint8 l_turn_on_off, uint8 battery_status)
               {
2 0     (T)    CtrlTtCheckBatteryStatus
                  uint8 TT_Status = l_turn_on_off;
                 /*
                  ** Check for LVI and HVI conditions and process the telltales
                  */
2 1     (T)(F)   if (
2 1.1   (T)(F)   1U == battery_status)
                   {
2 2     (T)(F)     if (
2 2.1   (T)(F)     tt_ctrl_ttconfig[index].LVSD_state == (1U))
                      {
                      /* If Low voltage is sensed and if the telltale's LVSD attribute is ON, turn the tt ON.*/
                      TT_Status = (1U);
                      }
                     else
                      {
                      /* If Low voltage is sensed and if the telltale's LVSD attribute is OFF, turn the tt OFF.*/
                     TT_Status = (0U);
                      }
                   }
                   else 
2 3     (T)(F)     if (
2 3.1   (T)(F)     2U == battery_status)
                   {
2 4     (T)(F)       if (
2 4.1   (T)(F)       tt_ctrl_ttconfig[index].HVSD_state == (1U))
                     {
                      /* If High voltage is sensed and if the telltale's HVSD attribute is ON, turn the tt ON.*/
                      TT_Status = (1U);
                     }
                    else
                     {
                       /* If High voltage is sensed and if the telltale's HVSD attribute is OFF, turn the tt OFF.*/
                      TT_Status = (0U);
                     }
                   }
                   else
                   {
                   // do nothing
                   }
                 return TT_Status;
                }
